reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Patient-paired multiomic treatment-associated program discovery, assay-specific preprocessing, primary late integration/enrichment and locked external cohort validation.

checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution plan to consult original assay Methods, supplements or validated analysis protocols and check their transfer to the present inputs.
No specimen identity/pairing integrity check or raw-data/sample manifest is specified.
Taking log paired differences is not a complete assay-specific normalization/filtering workflow; input scales, zeros and platform-conditional procedures remain unresolved.
No independent assay reference/blank/replicate calibration with quantitative accuracy/precision acceptance criteria.
No explicit program-score formula, orientation, units and missing-modality/feature denominator for comparable validation scores.
No variance/power or precision calculation for patient-level discovery and validation replication.
External sealing is clear, but label-blind technical QC or an equivalent protection against outcome-guided filtering in development is missing.
The validation test alternatives lack a selection/assumption rule, confidence intervals and a defined multiplicity family across selected factors/pathways.

checks.quote: using them to extract concordant, biologically meaningful metabolite signals
checks.reason: Cross-omic covariance cannot identify a time/batch-confounded metabolite effect. A shared-factor model does not distinguish shared technical and biological variation automatically. MOFA principles and likelihood/centering assumptions are not specified.
Selecting K by in-sample explained variance without held-out reconstruction/stability penalization favors complexity; a bounded K list alone is not a valid selection criterion.
No refreeze and fresh independent confirmation after model/assay changes prompted by failure.

checks.quote: highest variance explained across all three omic layers
checks.reason: High variance across patient delta vectors is response heterogeneity, not evidence of a mean treatment-associated shift. The variance/enrichment gate lacks a tested paired program mean and nuisance-identifiability condition.
External paired structure and feature availability are assumptions, not checked compatibility gates; the plan does not operationalize an independent test if these fail.
No immutable input manifest, exact code/environment/seed/command records or complete output provenance.
Filtering, K selection and missingness calibration lack patient-grouped train/tune separation; model selection uses the same fitted data.
Randomly masking complete data tests artificial missingness, not informative missing assays. No explicit MAR/MNAR sensitivity and no dependence-aware enrichment null/tested universe are defined.
No numerical table/figure rerun, clean environment, tolerances or resource/failure/source-difference logs.

The answer recognizes patient pairing, packet constraints and an external holdout, but its central cross-omic anchoring cannot recover a confounded metabolite effect. High-variance factor discovery does not establish a paired mean response. Operational statistical and reproducibility safeguards are largely absent.
